chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, that he said:
There is no shortening for the sailors on their ships, nor for the mule-driver and the camel-driver.

key_terms.الْمُكَارِي: the mule-driver or one who hires out riding animals
key_terms.تَقْصِيرٌ: shortening of the prayer during travel

ai.seo_question: Do sailors and professional transport workers shorten their prayer while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat during travel. It states that certain people whose occupation regularly involves travel, such as sailors, mule-drivers, and camel-drivers, do not perform shortened prayer in these circumstances.
